FACT_ID: sec09-R01 | anchor: A01
Your own blind spots need mirror setup plus head checks, while others' blind spots need you to speed up or drop back out [A01].
Why it matters: group blind-spots; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F01, sec09-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec09-R02 | anchor: A01
Turning drivers wait out full crossings, while cane, guide-dog, and lawful crossings demand full stops backed by a Class 1 misdemeanor [A01].
Why it matters: group pedestrians; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec09-F04, sec09-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec09-R03 | anchor: A01
Bicyclists may take the lane center and most roads, while drivers owe them three feet, lane changes, and empty bike lanes [A01].
Why it matters: group bicycles; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec09-F06, sec09-F07 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec09-R04 | anchor: A01
Bikes need checks at six maneuver points for their slipperiness, while motorcycles need double looks for their invisibility [A01].
Why it matters: group two-wheelers; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F08, sec09-F09 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec09-R05 | anchor: A01
Motorcycles gain an extra following second doubled in weather, plus bans on tailgating and lane sharing [A01].
Why it matters: group two-wheelers; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F10 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec09-R06 | anchor: A02
Light rail forbids circling gates and stopping on tracks, while demanding train expectation, double looks, and full clearance [A02].
Why it matters: group light-rail; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F11 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec09-R07 | anchor: A02
Low-speed vehicles run twenty-one to twenty-five on roads of thirty-five or less, while golf carts are not low-speed vehicles at all [A02].
Why it matters: group slow-vehicles; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F12 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec09-R08 | anchor: A02
Side zones hide you beside wide-turning trucks, rear zones hide you behind sudden stoppers, and front zones punish early cut-ins [A02].
Why it matters: group no-zones; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec09-F14, sec09-F15, sec09-F16 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec09-R09 | anchor: A02
Passing returns need the whole truck front in the mirror at steady speed, while turning trucks forbid squeezing past at all [A02].
Why it matters: group no-zones; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec09-F16, sec09-F17 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-va-s:virginia-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec09-R10 | anchor: A02
Trailers double every maneuver's effort, matching trucks' near-double stopping demand [A02].
Why it matters: group no-zones; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec09-F18, sec09-F16 [A02].
